notes.title: [BODYCAM] Roadmap Update : What's Coming Next ?!
notes.content:
[h1]🔧 Roadmap Update – Optimization, Loadout, Zombie & More[/h1]
Hi everyone,

We’re kicking off a new format here on Steam: [b]regular updates on our roadmap progress[/b].
We usually post [i]dev leaks[/i] (images, info, early previews) on our [url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadstudio]official Discord[/url], but since not everyone is there, we’ll now keep you updated here as well.

👉 [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2406770/view/502817574909644245]Click here to view the full roadmap[/url]

This part is being handled by a [b]specialized team[/b], and they’ve already delivered key updates:
[list]  [*][b]DLSS integration[/b][/*]  [*][b]Performance and stability improvements[/b][/*]  [*][b]Polish passes across various systems[/b][/*][/list]
However, this section is [b]still ongoing[/b].

notes.title: Bodycam Hotfix V0.1.3.5 - Performance & Gameplay Fixes
notes.content:
[h2][b]Bodycam Update – Hotfix V0.1.3.5 [/b][/h2]

Hey everyone

[b]We've just released last day, our biggest update yet[/b], and now here's [b]Hotfix V0.1.3.5[/b], fixing several issues and improving overall gameplay.  

Here’s what’s new:

[list]
[*][b]Performance fixes[/b] on [i]Russian Building, Worn House, Hospital[/i], and other maps.[i](We've made some improvements, but keep in mind that the big performance update is coming in the next update!)[/i]

[*][b]Rank rewards adjustments[/b] - No rank rewards when playing with bots and fewer than 3 real players.
[*][b]Hardpoint mode now ends at 200 points[/b] - Let us know if this feels too short!
[*][b]Bots now stay in matches[/b] - As asked, bots will now stay in matches until the lobby starts filling up with real players.
[*][b]Bot fixes[/b] - Bots now shoot properly, and their accuracy against other bots has been improved.
[*][b]Zombie skins fixed[/b] - They now appear correctly instead of using test assets.
[*][b]Improved match stability[/b] - Reduced chances of matches stopping abruptly.
[/list]

[center][i]As always, let us know your feedback - Thanks for your support![/i][/center]

notes.title: Bodycam Update V0.1.3.4 - Season 2, Bots, and Bug Fixes!
notes.content:
[b]Bodycam Update V0.1.3.4 - [14/3/2025][/b]  

⚠️ [b]NOTE:[/b] 
[*]This update focuses on new content, and semi-major bug fixes, while the optimizations are being handled by a specialized team and will roll out progressively. 
[*]We would also like to mention that because of so many additions introduced in this update, there could be many bugs that we missed during bug testing stages. If you find any, please report them on our [url=https://discord.gg/reissadstudio]discord[/url]! 
[*]Thank you for your patience and support while we continue improving Bodycam!

---  

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]  

[b]🏆 SEASON 2 BEGINS![/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Ranks have been reset!:[/b] Players now have 60 days to climb the leaderboard before the season ends, and earn exclusive rewards! 
[*] [b]Season Rewards:[/b] You are now able to claim [b]exclusive badges[/b] as rewards for your rank position in the previous season, and [b]new operator skins[/b] for season 2!
[*] [b]View Past Rankings:[/b] You can now check your rank history by visiting the [b]Leaderboard[/b] section and selecting previous seasons.!
[*] [b]Season Duration:[/b] This season will run for [b]two months[/b], but we may adjust future seasons based on your feedback. Let us know if you prefer shorter or longer seasons!  
[*] [b]Rank Placement Change:[/b] The amount of [b]points needed to rank up has been increased exponentially[/b], making the grind [b]harder[/b] and more [b]pleasing[/b]! This change is [b]not final[/b] though, we appreciate any feedback!
[/list]  

[b]🔥 STREAK SYSTEM - DAILY FREE SKINS![/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Daily Win Rewards:[/b] Win one match per day to earn a [b]free skin.[/b]  
[*] [b]No Duplicate Skins:[/b] Skins are chosen from those you [b]do not own yet[/b].  
[*] [b]Consistency Matters:[/b] If you [b]miss a day, your streak resets![/b] Stay [b]consistent[/b] to maximize your rewards.  
[*] [b]Future Updates:[/b] More streak-based rewards will be added in [b]future updates!  [/b]
[/list]  

[b]🎯 NEW GAME MODE - HARDPOINT[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Objective-Based Gameplay:[/b] Hardpoint is a [b]fast-paced[/b] mode where teams must [b]capture and hold[/b] a rotating zone to earn points.  
[*] [b]Winning Conditions:[/b] The team that reaches [b]200 points first, or has the most points by the end of the timer[/b] wins!
[*] [b]Rotating Capture Points:[/b] The [b]zone moves periodically[/b], forcing players to anticipate rotations and reposition before the enemy does.  
[*] [b]The More The Better:[/b] The [b]more teammates[/b] you have on the [b]hardpoint[/b], the [b]more points[/b] your team receives!
[*] [b]Best for Tactical Players:[/b] Hardpoint is [b]perfect[/b] for those who enjoy a mix of [b]team strategy[/b] and [b]aggressive[/b] play-styles. Try it out, and let us know your feedback!  
[/list]  

[b]🗺️ NEW MAP - PAINTBALL ARENA[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Designed for Competitive Modes:[/b] A [b]paintball-inspired map[/b] tailored for [b]Versus, Body Bomb, and Hardpoint[/b] game modes.  
[*] [b]Ground-Level Combat:[/b] Unlike Airsoft, Bomb House, or Russian Building, [b]this map has no elevated areas[/b], ensuring a level playing field.  
[*] [b]Cover-Based Movement:[/b] Small, scattered [b]covers[/b] force players to stay [b]mobile and react quickly[/b] to enemy movement.  
[*] [b]Symmetrical Layout:[/b] The map is [b]evenly designed[/b], providing a balanced and fair competitive experience.  
[/list]  

---  

[b]🤖 BOTS - DYNAMIC MATCHMAKING AI[/b]  
[i]NOTE: The bots are not perfect just yet, and will be improved over time![/i]
[list]  
[*] [b]Dynamic Matchmaking Support:[/b] Bots [b]automatically fill empty slots[/b] and [b]leave as real players join[/b]. They are designed to [b]maintain the game’s pacing and balance.[/b]  
[*] [b]Filling Lobbies & Expanding Player Base:[/b] Bots have been added to [b]ensure that matches feel full[/b] and [b]competitive[/b], particularly in regions where the player base is still growing. This helps Bodycam [b]expand globally[/b] and improves matchmaking speeds.  
[*] [b]Adaptive AI Difficulty:[/b] Bots [b]start at an easier level[/b] but [b]dynamically adjust their difficulty[/b] based [b]on player performance[/b]. If you're dominating, they will get [b]smarter and more challenging[/b] for you.  
[*] [b]Realistic Player Behavior:[/b] Bots [b]analyze the battlefield[/b], take alternative routes, use flanking tactics, and engage dynamically in fights.  
[*] [b]Objective-Focused AI:[/b] Bots [b]interact with objectives just like real players[/b]; They plant and defuse bombs, capture Hardpoints, and support their team in tactical engagements.  
[*] [b]Option to disable bots:[/b] If you're hosting a match, you can [b]disable bots in the settings[/b] before starting a match!  
[*] [b]Bot Kill Point Rewards:[/b] Killing a bot [b]grants ¼ of a player kill's value[/b]. For example, if a player kill grants 40 RPoints, a bot kill will grant 10 RPoints.
[*] [b]Temporary bot limit:[/b] For testing, bots will [b]fill lobbies up to 4 players[/b] for the time being![/list]  

---  

[b]🌍 MAP REWORKS & FIXES[/b]  
We have started reworking several maps to improve visual quality, level design, and balance. However, this is just the beginning! These improvements are [b]not[/b] final. This is a first step to better organization and testing community feedback before the [b]full map overhauls planned in the 2025 roadmap.[/b]

[list]  
[*] [b]Worn House Revamped:[/b] Improved textures, lighting, and overall level design for better balance and visuals.  
[*] [b]Russian Building Now Features a Redesigned Outside Area:[/b] Expanded for more strategic opportunities and improved navigation.  
[*] [b]A New Staircase Has Been Added To Russian Building:[/b] Changing the way players navigate and making gameplay more dynamic.
[*] [b]Airsoft House Optimizations:[/b] The map has seen a considerable amount of changes and optimizations, removing annoying spots and more, making gameplay smoother and more enjoyable.
[*] [b]Training Range Now Has New Guns:[/b] FOSTECH shotgun and Revolver have been added to training range for everyone to test them out!  
[*] [b]Countless hitboxes fixed across all the maps:[/b] Including Russian Building trees, Rome's bushes, and more!
[*] [b]"Logistics" Was temporarily disabled for a small rework[/b]  
[/list]  

---  

[b]🎨 SKINS & CUSTOMIZATION UPDATES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]37+7 New Operator Skins Added![/b] There's 37 new skins you can buy in the shop, and 7 more you can get from season rewards!
[*] [b]A handful of new weapons skins![/b] A couple more weapon skins were added this update for some guns!
[*] [b]New National Flag Badges Added:[/b] Represent your country with pride! All nations now have unique flag badges.  
[*] [b]More Badges Coming Soon:[/b] Future updates will introduce new badges with different meanings and significance.  
[*] [b]Profile Picture Now Reflects Your Operator Skin:[/b] Your in-game avatar is now represented by your chosen operator skin, adding more immersion and natural team identification. We would like your feedback regarding this change, let us know if you like it or not!
[/list]  

---  

[b]OTHER ADDITIONS, CHANGES, FIXES & POLISH[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Added voice lines that play at start of rounds and other situations[/b]  
[*] [b]Added [RADIO] audio setting, that controls the previously mentioned voice lines[/b]  
[*] [b]Added Take/Interact key bind option (Default: E)[/b]  
[*] [b]Added a new scope[/b]  
[*] [b]Added new walking sounds[/b]  
[*] [b]Reworked Main Menu UI completely[/b]  
[i]Note: [u]UI Bugs are still present, this is just the first part of the UI rework![/u][/i]
[*] [b]Nerfed and Buffed rank point rewards for certain gamemodes[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved and adjusted the friendly name UI[/b] 
[*] [b]Team killers are now automatically kicked after 3 TKs, regardless of their performance in the match[/b] 
[*] [b]Friendly "Green Box" no longer disappears when too close, minimizing confusion and accidental team kills[/b] 
[*] [b]Joining a match too late will no longer grant you any rewards, preventing players from abusing the system by joining late and getting free rewards.[/b] 
[*] [b]Players will no longer earn any points in private matches. These games will be purely for practice.[/b] 
[*] [b]RTSS (Riva Tuner Statistics Server) works again[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved the player hit registration[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved issues with body bomb rounds not ending properly[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved issue where lasers unintentionally lit up entire rooms[/b]  
[*] [b]Improved issues with private lobbies not working[/b]  
[*] [b]Resolved issues with pump shotgun and revolver getting stuck[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issue with weapon skins not saving if you don't have an operator skin equipped[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issues with the resolution not being saved[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issues with the shop being empty[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issues with the bomb not dropping from dead players[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed issue where lasers caused a large red flash when turned on[/b]  
[*] [b]Fixed bug that disabled the green box and names of friendlies at the start of a match[/b]  
[*] [b]Players can no longer steal the bomb from a teammate[/b]  
[*] [b]Ranks are now spelled correctly[/b]  
[*] [b]Voice chat volume is no longer affected by the "Master Volume" setting[/b]

notes.title: Bodycam 2025 - Q&A 2025 Answered
notes.content:
[h1]❓ Bodycam 2025 - Q&A ❓[/h1]

Hey everyone!  

We know that after our recent announcements, many of you have [b]questions about what’s coming next[/b]. We took the time to [b]anticipate the most common ones[/b] and decided to put together this [b]Q&A[/b] to provide [b]clear answers[/b] on all key topics!  

Of course, if you still have more questions or want to stay up to date with everything happening around Bodycam, [b]join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadstudio]Discord[/url]![/b]  

Thank you all for your continued support. We hope these answers help you get [b]a better understanding of what’s ahead[/b], show our [b]commitment to transparency[/b], and most importantly, [b]get you excited for the future![/b] 🚀🔥  


[h2]❓ How did we start in the game industry?[/h2]  

We started developing games over ten years ago, beginning with small projects that allowed us to grow and refine our skills. Over the years, we explored Unreal Engine, mastered its tools, and improved our creations.

When Unreal Engine 5 was released, it marked a turning point in the industry with its groundbreaking realism. During a school study project at the launch of UE5, we discovered photorealism. The goal of this project was to explore the engine’s limits, and as we progressed, we realized that our PC was capable of running an ultra-realistic scene.

Initially, our idea was to create an ultra-realistic shooter on UE5. But during our prototypes, we discovered that the only way to push realism from “realistic” to “photorealistic” was by degrading the image using lens effects that mimic action cameras.

You’ve probably noticed that all recent ultra-realistic games adopt camera effects degradations. It’s the same principle used in cinema: in action scenes, everything moves, everything is blurry, making it harder to distinguish details and, ultimately, making the scene feel more believable.

Of course, we agreed that this degradation would feel odd if it came directly from the player’s eyes. So, we justified this effect by incorporating bodycams equipped by soldiers this became the name of our game.


[h2]⚙️ Game Optimisation & Technical Improvements [/h2]  

[list]  
[b]What are your plans for game optimisation?[/b]  
➡️ Optimisation is a [b]major focus[/b], and our [b]specialised team[/b] is working on improving performance with every update. We’re even planning [b]a dedicated optimisation update[/b] in the future.  

[b]Why was DLSS removed, and will it return?[/b]  
➡️ DLSS interfered with FSR, causing [b]major lag issues[/b]. A team is investigating, and [b]DLSS will return once the issue is fixed[/b].  

[b]Will there be host migration & dedicated servers?[/b]  
➡️ A [b]specialised team is working on host migration[/b] to improve online play. Dedicated servers were [b]not recommended[/b] for our current game modes, but with [b]host migration, things will get much better![/b]  

[b]Will an anti-cheat system be implemented?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! A [b]robust anti-cheat solution[/b] is in development to ensure fair play.  
[/list]  


[h2]🔫 Gameplay & Content Additions [/h2]

[list]  
[b]Will night vision be added?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! [b]Night Vision Goggles (NVG)[/b] will be available in [b]special rounds[/b], where unique gameplay modifiers like suppressed weapons will also be introduced.  

[b]Are bots planned?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! Bots will arrive in [b]update 1.3.4[/b], with difficulty that [b]adapts to player skill levels[/b].  

[b]Will there be snipers & sniper-focused maps?[/b]  
➡️ Snipers are coming [b]after the animation overhaul[/b].  

[b]Will weapon customisation be added?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! Attachments and sights will be introduced [b]alongside loadouts[/b], which will be available in [b]non-competitive game modes like Deathmatch[/b].  

[b]Will there be more zombie maps?[/b]  
➡️ Definitely! [b]New zombie maps are coming[/b], but they take [b]a lot of development time[/b].  

[b]Will there be a campaign mode?[/b]  
➡️ Not initially planned, but we’ll [b]run a community poll[/b]

[b]Will hostage rescue be a game mode?[/b]  
➡️ Same Not initially planned, but we’ll [b]run a community poll[/b] to see if players want it!  

[b]Will more lens effects be added?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! [b]Snow, blood, and more immersive effects[/b] are in the works.  

[b]Is a gore system planned?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! A [b]fully custom gore system[/b] is in development, and we’ve already shown some WIP footage on Discord.  

[b]Will more weapons be added?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! Can’t reveal which ones yet, but [b]stay tuned![/b]  

[b]Will kill cams be added?[/b]  
➡️ No plans for now—it’s a [b]complex feature to implement properly[/b].  
[/list]  


[h2]🎮 Customisation & Quality of Life Improvements [/h2]

[list]  
[b]Why were player cosmetics changed? Will the old system return?[/b]  
➡️ The old system caused [b]performance and engine issues[/b], so we had to replace it. We’ll announce any future changes if we find a workaround!  

[b]Will the friend system be improved?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! The [b]party system is getting major improvements in update 1.3.4[/b].  

[b]Will Proximity Chat & VOIP be fixed?[/b]  
➡️ Yes! [b]Fixes are in development[/b] to make it work properly.  

[b]Will daily & weekly challenges be added?[/b]  
➡️ Yes, they are [b]planned for a future update![/b]  

[b]Will there be tactical emotes or hand signs?[/b]  
➡️ No “Fortnite-style” emotes, but [b]custom animations for match intros/outros[/b] are coming!  

[b]Will HDR support return?[/b]  
➡️ HDR was [b]temporarily disabled for rework[/b], but it will return in an improved form.  
[/list]  


[h2]🛠️ Other Features & Future Plans [/h2]  

[list]  
[b]Will there be mod support?[/b]  
➡️ Not planned [b]for now[/b], but we may explore it in the far future.  

[b]Will there be a drone racing mode?[/b]  
➡️ Maybe 😉  

[b]How did the studio start in the gaming industry?[/b]  
➡️ We started [b]six years ago[/b] with small projects, building our skills over time. Once [b]Unreal Engine 5[/b] launched, we started working on [b]Worst World[/b], which evolved into [b]BODYCAM[/b]!  

[b]What’s the current state of Reissad Studio?[/b]  
➡️ [b]We’re growing fast![/b] More details coming in an upcoming announcement.  

[b]What happened to the map "Tumblewood"?[/b]  
➡️ It had [b]major performance & graphical issues[/b], so we had to [b]temporarily disable it[/b]. We’ll bring it back once it’s fixed!  

[b]Will animations be improved?[/b]  
➡️ [b]An animation overhaul is already in progress![/b]  

[b]Will left-handed POV be added?[/b]  
➡️ [b]Not likely[/b]—it would require a [b]completely new set of animations[/b] for every gun.  

[b]Playstation & Xbox versions?[/b]  
➡️ [b]CLASSIFIED.[/b]
[/list]  


[h2]📢 Stay Updated! [/h2]

We hope this [b]Q&A[/b] answers most of your questions! If you have more, [b]join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadstudio]Discord[/url] to ask directly![/b]  

🔥 [b]The future of Bodycam is bigger than ever, and we’re excited to share this journey with you all![/b] 🚀

[b]Bodycam Update V0.1.3.3 - November 11, 2024[/b]

⚠️ [b]NOTE:[/b] This update focuses on new content, while bug fixes are being handled by a specialized team and will roll out progressively. We appreciate your patience and support as we continue improving Bodycam.

[b]NEW CONTENT[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Rome (New Map):[/b] A large, intricately designed map featuring a mix of open spaces and tight corridors. Optimized for Bomb Mode, it introduces multiple strategic planting zones to intensify tactical gameplay.  
[*] [b]Logistics (New Map):[/b] One of the smallest maps in Bodycam, tailored for Versus Mode and 1v1 Duel Mode. Designed for close-quarters combat, it ensures action-packed matches as opposing teams face off head-to-head.  
[*] [b]Oil Rig Returns:[/b] Back by popular demand, this map has been reintroduced with some incomplete features (e.g., missing floors). Improvements will continue based on community feedback.  
[*] [b]Tumblewood Temporarily Disabled:[/b] This map is currently under rework. Stay tuned for updates!  
[/list]  

[b]CHANGES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Bomb Mode Zones:[/b] Added strategic A, B, and C planting zones. Planting here cuts detonation time in half, offering more tactical depth. Default planting rules remain for strategic flexibility.  
[*] [b]Versus Rounds Adjustments:[/b] Reduced the number of rounds to win from seven to five. Sides now switch after two or three rounds, depending on progress, for faster, more dynamic matches.  
[*] [b]Lighting and Shadow Fixes:[/b] Shadows are now enforced for all players, preventing unfair advantages from file manipulation while maintaining immersion.  
[*] [b]Bad Host Punishment:[/b] Hosts that leave before the match ends will now be penalized.  
[*] [b]General Map Updates:[/b] Minor tweaks and adjustments have been made to improve gameplay flow and visuals across all maps.  
[/list]  

[b]FIXES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] [b]Lighting Exploits:[/b] Fixed bugs allowing players to disable shadows unfairly.  
[*] [b]Generator Timing in Zombie Mode:[/b] Resolved issues where generators activated at incorrect intervals.  
[*] [b]Collision in Pit Mode:[/b] Improved collision mechanics for smoother gameplay.  
[*] [b]Bomb Mode Timers:[/b] Adjusted planting and detonation mechanics for better balance.  
[/list]  

[b]OTHER CHANGES[/b]  
[list]  
[*] 8 new skins added.  
[*] R point rewards and shop prices adjusted.  
[*] Vaulting mechanics limited for realism and to prevent accessing unreachable spots.  
[*] Teams with friends now auto-balance better.  
[*] Knife knockback adjusted.  
[*] Grenade kills now count properly.  
[*] Fixed collision and stuck spots across all maps.  
[*] "The Pit" mode renamed to "Duel."  
[*] Kicking disabled in GunGame and Deathmatch modes due to abuse.  
[*] Scoreboard and lobby settings improvements.  
[*] Fixed labels in settings for better clarity.  
[/list]  

[b]RANK RESET & SEASONS (COMMUNITY SUGGESTION)[/b]  
We are exploring the idea of a rank reset paired with a seasonal structure to enhance the competitive experience:  
[list]  
[*] [b]Season Duration:[/b] Each season will last 1-2 months, with ranks resetting at the end.  
[*] [b]Seasonal Rewards:[/b] Earn exclusive skins based on your rank at the season's end.  
[*] [b]Rank History:[/b] Track your performance and ranks across previous seasons in a dedicated section.  
[/list]  

💬 [b]Community Question:[/b] Should we start the next season immediately (with rewards distributed later) or wait until the reward system is fully implemented? Share your thoughts in the ⁠Suggestions channel!  

Thank you for your continued support, and see you on the battlefield!

notes.title: BODYCAM HELP - ACCESSIBILITY AND PERFORMANCE TIPS !
notes.content:
[b][h3]IN-GAME ASSISTANCE AND PERFORMANCE TIPS[/h3][/b]

[b]Hello Bodycam Community![/b]

We hope you are all excited for the game release on June 7, 2024! We wanted to take a moment to provide tips on how to optimize your gameplay experience.
Our goal is to highlight all the new questions that bodycam brings and to provide you with our answers!

[b][h3]PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION[/h3][/b]

[u][b]The game performs better than you might expect.[/b][/u] If you have any doubts, please check the minimum requirements on Steam or simply ask our community on [url=discord.gg/reissadstudio]Discord[/url], who can give you an [b]approximate idea of the FPS you can expect![/b]

For the best gaming experience, you might need to adjust some settings, especially if you encounter FPS drops or motion sickness. Here are some tips:

➡️ [b]FPS Issues and FSR/DLSS Settings[/b]:
To improve your frame rate, consider enabling FidelityFX Super Resolution (FSR). This feature can significantly boost your FPS without sacrificing too much visual quality. To enable FSR:
1. Go to Settings > Graphics.
2. Enable FSR and adjust the level according to your preference.

Additionally, you can enable [b]FSR Frame Generation[/b], which can greatly increase your FPS:
1. Go to Settings > Graphics.
2. Enable FSR Frame Generation to benefit from higher frame rates.

➡️ [b]Lower Graphics[/b]:
1. Go to Settings > Graphics.
2. Put in HIGH (except motion blur)

DO NOT TOUCH ANY OTHER SETTINGS YOU DONT KNOW

We are also working on integrating NVIDIA DLSS, which will be available soon to further enhance your gaming performance. Keep an eye out for this update!

[b][h3]POTENTIAL MOTION SICKNESS[/h3][/b]

[b]We have noticed that some players might experience motion sickness while watching videos[/b] of the game. [b]HOWEVER[/b], [b][u]when playing, this is significantly reduced as you control your character and are actively engaged in the action.[/u][/b] 
Therefore, very few players actually need to activate the following settings:

➡️ [b]Camera Sensitivity[/b]: Lower the camera sensitivity to reduce rapid movements.
➡️ [b]Camera Shake[/b]: Turn off camera shake effects in the Settings menu.
➡️ [b]Lean Settings[/b]: Adjusting the lean settings to improve your comfort while playing: [b]Toggle vs. Hold Lean[/b]: Choose between toggle or hold for leaning, based on your preference, in the Settings > Controls menu.

We hope these tips help enhance your gaming experience. Your comfort and enjoyment are our top priorities!

[b][h3]FEEDBACK AND SUPPORT[/h3][/b]

Remember, your feedback is crucial in helping us improve Bodycam. If you encounter any bugs or have suggestions, please report them in our [url=https://discord.gg/reissadstudio]Discord[/url] channels:
- ⁠[b]🔧┆bug[/b]
- ⁠[b]🚧┆feedback[/b]

Thank you for being a part of our community and for helping us make Bodycam the best it can be. We can't wait to hear your thoughts and see you in the game!

[b]The Reissad Studio Team[/b]

Well, well, well, it's finally time...

[h3]ROAD MAP 2024 BRIEFING[/h3][/b]

We have some great news to share with you today! Thanks to your valuable feedback during the playtest session, most of the issues encountered by players have now been fixed.

We are excited to present our roadmap for 2024, starting with the release of Bodycam in early access.
ㅤ
[b]Since Q2 is already well underway and ends in late June[/b], it isn't as packed as the other periods. However, this will give you an idea of the direction we're heading and the points we're revealing today.

At the start of each quarter, we will launch community requests, allowing you to vote for the best ideas to be integrated into the game. These ideas will come from the ⁠suggestions channel ([url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadstudio]on discord[/url]) where everyone can create suggestions and vote for their favorites.

[b]It's important to note that this roadmap is not set in stone[/b], and we will likely add new features based on our progress. [u][b]This roadmap was determined as if we continued to work as a team of two, but with ongoing recruitment, the roadmap will expand in the future![/b][/u]

You can soon find more detailed points on our website: [url=reissad.com/RoadMap]reissad.com/RoadMap[/url]. We won't reveal everything, as we want to keep some surprises for you, and because in game development, it's possible to deviate a bit from the initial plan.

Thank you all, you can already start making suggestions now, and the first community request will begin in early July!

Have a great day, and see you in-game!

notes.title: Early-Access Playtest #1
notes.content:
[b][h3]PLAYTEST INFORMATION[/h3][/b]

[b]First join our Discord Server[/b] : [url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadStudio]Click Here[/url]

The first [b]official playtest session[/b] will be taking place on sunday, [b]January 21st at 0 AM[/b] (UTC+1).
This phase is open to everyone wishing to participate and will be going on [b]for 24 hours after opening[/b], meaning until January [b]22 at 0 AM[/b] (UTC+1).
The main purpose of this phase is for our team to receive as much feedback from the players as possible to know what to fix and improve.
Also it should be noted that the game [b]is in early access[/b] and that we will announce a [b]road map soon[/b]!
If encounter any [b]bug or want to give us any feedback[/b], please make sure to read further to see how to report that to us.
For this phase, the Steam system will once again randomly accept people between the registered access requests. We will try and set the number of accepted players as fair as possible for everyone to [b]get a chance to experience Bodycam.[/b]

[b][h3]OUR ANSWERS TO YOUR POTENTIAL QUESTIONS[/h3]
[/b]
➡️ [b]How do I participate in the stress-test debug and/or playtest phase?[/b]

Like last time, on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2406770/Bodycam/]Bodycam's Steam page[/url] you will see a new banner saying [b]"Play the Bodycam Playtest now!"[/b], with a green "Play Now" button. Clicking on it will send a request to be accepted. 
[b]Also click on the button above wishlisting Bodycam greatly helps us[/b], so be sure to do it if you haven't already!

We will use Steam's system which [b]will randomly[/b] select a number of people [b]to accept[/b]. Please note that [b]we don't have any control over the random selection system.[/b]

➡️ [b]What will I be able to discover?[/b]
As the stress-test phase we organized last week, you will only be able to play on a [b]limited[/b] set of three maps: Worn House, Russian Building and Airsoft House. The two main games modes we developed, solo deathmatch and team deathmatch, are fully available during the playtest.

➡️ [b]How much storage do I need to download the playtest version?[/b]
The new playtest version size should be near last week's one, but as we are currently fixing some issues, the size might be a bit bigger. [b]Try to save 20 GB of free space[/b] on your disc to ensure you'll be able to download the game.

➡️ [b]How do I report bugs or give feedbacks to the developers?[/b]
First [b]join our Discord Server[/b] : [url=https://discord.com/invite/reissadStudio]Click Here[/url]
Like last week, we will be using two new channels: ⁠[b]🔧┆bugs-playtest[/b], where you will be able to report any kind of bugs or things you judge that has to be noticed by the developers. If you don't have any bugs to report but still want to give any feedback, please make sure to do so in ⁠[b]🚧┆feedback-playtest.[/b]

Once again, that's it! If you have any other questions please make sure to ask it in the general chat.

For those who weren't part of last week's stress-test, we sincerely hope you will all like discovering [b]Bodycam for the first time[/b]. And for all the people who will come back and play, [b]we hope you'll all have a great time![/b]

[b]The Reissad Studio Team[/b]
